verdict.rationale: Warp is a payroll product: its agent runs payroll [warp-payroll-docs-20], it stores worker bank accounts [warp-payroll-docs-15], and it pays contractors in local currency [warp-payroll-docs-22]. Together these imply electronic payment to bank accounts rather than checks, but direct deposit is never explicitly documented and no deposit speed is stated. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of employee direct deposit, any stated next-day or 2-day deposit timing, independent or hands-on corroboration.
